Tara M.: Quick sync — I'm putting together a minimal control-plane surface for customers on VPC peering. High-level ask: what breakage modes do we need to guarantee no-data-path downtime for?
Kevin L.: TL;DR: preserve tenant-egress-srcip when peering, prefer hairpin elimination, fallback to regional-relay if routes flap
Raj P.: Two failure modes to plan for: 1) peering route flap, 2) controlplane token expiry mid-cutover causing config drift
Julia Z.: Also watch cert rotation race across peering — saw a weird case where sidecar retried 100x when certs were rotated simultaneously
Tara M.: Right. Proposal: 1) short-lived certs + staggered CA rotation, 2) dual-path during switchover (peer + relay) for 5m window, 3) graceful connection draining and KV-cache syncing
Kevin L.: +1. Need an operator API to set 'cutover_mode=dual-path' per-tenant and a TTL for automatic revert
Raj P.: Ops checklist idea: prewarm relay capacity, reserve SNAT IP blocks for the tenant, and bake healthchecks that prefer L7 failure semantics not just L3
Julia Z.: Suggest adding a small in-proxy config toggle: `fallback_prefer = "relay" | "peer"` so teams can opt into their preference quickly
Tara M.: Example operator command for toggling cutover mode:
```
PATCH /api/v1/tenants/1234
{"cutover_mode":"dual-path","preferred":"peer","revert_after_secs":300}
```
Kevin L.: Concern: metrics duplication and billing — dual-path will duplicate egress tokens. Need tagging to avoid double-billing and metric dedupe in aggregation layer
Raj P.: We can flag requests with `cutover=true` header and have the billing/metrics pipeline dedupe based on token+cutover tag, or emit sample_rate=0.5 for relay path during window
infra-bot: autoscaler: relay-group-3 autoscaled from 8 -> 24 in last 20m for test tenants (triggered by TCP slow-open growth)
Tara M.: Good catch from infra-bot. We'll add a prewarm threshold (2x baseline) for 10m during any scheduled cutover to avoid autoscaling thrash
Julia Z.: Also: add a post-cutover verification sweep that validates `src_ip_preserved` boolean and `kv_cache_consistent` for sampled requests
Kevin L.: I'll own the operator API and the revert timer behavior. I'll add an API flag to simulate dual-path in prod-readonly to test the dedupe logic
Raj P.: I'll own relay prewarm + SNAT reservation and write the smoke tests for srcip preservation and idempotent retries
Julia Z.: I'll work with platform on the cert rotation sequencing and a runbook snippet: stagger CA pushes with 30s delay per region, then verify handshake success rates
Tara M.: Next actions: I'll draft an RFC with a sequence diagram + rollback plan. Also schedule a 30m dry-run Thurs 10:00am PT. Need list of tenants to test and a rollback playbook by EOD Thu
Kevin L.: Test tenants: tenant-qa-1, tenant-staging, tenant-enterprise-5 (added to test queue)
Raj P.: I'll add smoke tests to CI and a traffic replay job to verify srcip and latency delta under dual-path
Julia Z.: I'll add the cert rotation checks and a post-cutover observability dashboard (cutover:latency, cutover:errors, srcip-preserved_pct)
Tara M.: Thanks. If no objections I'll post the RFC tomorrow and tag eng-platform + infra for review. Any objections?
Kevin L.: :thumbsup:
Raj P.: :thumbsup:
Julia Z.: :+1:
